Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q2 2023 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of GS.
We delivered record revenue of $43.4 billion this quarter, representing 17% year-over-year growth.
We expect revenues to grow approximately 17% to 22% next quarter, subject to market conditions.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q2 2023.
We are reaffirming our full-year guidance and raising our EPS outlook to $6.49 per share.
While we remain optimistic, there can be no assurance that macroeconomic headwinds won't affect demand.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
Are you seeing any signs of demand elasticity in your enterprise segment?
Thank you for the question. Our gross margin expanded by 38 basis points to 28.9%, reflecting improved operational efficiency.
Second question - Analyst:
How are you thinking about pricing power versus volume growth in the current environment?
We expect revenues to grow approximately 17% to 22% next quarter, subject to market conditions.
